candidate_workaround: Pass the ripgrep alternation as one PowerShell single-quoted literal so embedded double quotes remain data rather than shell syntax.
failure_signature: PowerShell parsed an embedded double quote inside a ripgrep alternation and rejected the command before search
recurrence_guard: PowerShell search expressions containing alternation or quote characters use literal-safe single-quoted arguments and are retried without broadening scope.
rollback: Retain the parser failure and do not treat it as search evidence; use only the successful literal-safe rerun.
scope_boundary: Owner-local tooling recovery only; no production, security, privacy-complete, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Quote PowerShell ripgrep alternations as literal arguments
